description.value:
Aeon armor is a magically enhanced suit of @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.equipment-srd.Item.Ceramic Plate] armor decorated in colors of green and gold and bearing the Eye of Aroden on the breastplate. A suit of aeon armor can be further enhanced by armor runes, but the suits worn by lower-ranking knights typically lack such enhancements.

An indentation in the middle of the Eye of Aroden that decorates the breastplate of a suit of aeon armor can hold a single aeon stone. Placing an aeon stone in this indentation provides you with all the benefits of having the aeon stone orbit your head, but it protects the stone from being noticed or stolen as easily. You invest aeon armor and the aeon stone within it simultaneously, and they count as only one item toward your investiture limit. An invested aeon stone slotted in aeon armor also grants its resonant power.

If you have more than one item with an invested aeon stone (such as if you carry a wayfinder with an invested aeon stone), destructive interference from their resonance prevents you from gaining benefits from any of them. You can still benefit from additional aeon stones orbiting your head, just not those fitted into aeon armor, wayfinders, or similar items.
